detailed_descriptions.en: ***NEW LEVEL 'VIKING' AVAILABLE NOW*** DAVE THE DIVER JOINS HUMAN FALL FLAT FOR A VIKING ADVENTURE A brand new Viking level for Human Fall Flat is available to download right now! As well as a whole lot of plunderous puzzle platforming for you to get stuck into, we’re also delighted to welcome DAVE THE DIVER to the Human crew! Download the update today and you’ll automatically unlock two completely new skins themed around everyone’s favourite deep sea diver. Explore a Viking-themed level packed with plenty of new platforming puzzles for you and your friends to sink your teeth into. Lay siege to the village on arrival, ride a catapult high up the mountainside, then blag a battering ram to slam a huge hunk of rock into the chasm ahead. Take a barrel-ride through the frosty fjords and join your friends on a longboat ride to victory! Enjoy Human Fall Flat in style with two new skins themed around our special guest star DAVE THE DIVER! Join 55 million players across all formats, and explore more than 5,000 unofficial levels from our community creators too! Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted physics platformer set in a world of floating dreamscapes. Each dream level provides a new environment to navigate, from mansions, castles and Aztec adventures to snowy mountains, eerie nightscapes and industrial locations. Multiple routes through each level, and perfectly playful puzzles ensure exploration and ingenuity are rewarded. Need a hand getting that boulder on to a catapult, or need someone to break that wall? Online multiplayer for up to 8 players transforms the way Human Fall Flat is played. Your Human is yours to customise. With outfits from builder to chef, skydiver, miner, astronaut and ninja. Choose your head, upper and lower body and get creative with the colours! The Human Fall Flat Workshop, unique to Steam, is a fantastic tool which, used alongside Unity, enables players to build their own Human Fall Flat content and share it with others around the world. Not interested in building levels, lobbies or skins yourself? You can also download more than 5000 different levels and explore other people's creations directly from Steam! Streamers and YouTubers flock to Human Fall Flat for its unique, hilarious gameplay. Fans have watched these videos more than 3 Billion times!
